summary: lightclient 提交 PR，给 EIP-8141 Frame 交易加入 PROOF 帧模式并把 leanSPHINCS 列为协议验证器，soispoke 则提议把 EIP-8288 的依赖声明放进签名列表，两种表达方式正在并行讨论。EF 博客发布 PQAI #1，推荐 Keccak-256 作为以太坊基于哈希的密码学的统一哈希，执行层客户端不需要引入新哈希。ERC-8511 Agent 账户注册表升级到 v3，评审者确认 minDelay 只约束发布者，不约束账户本身。

items.topic: Frame 交易怎么表达签名：PROOF 帧还是签名列表
items.title: PR #12714：EIP-8141 加入 PROOF 帧模式
items.note: 2026-11-25 02:59 创建（lightclient，仍为开放状态）。作者说团队一直在争论 signature_list 是否足够、能否向前兼容，他倾向引入专门表达密码学声明的帧模式，这借鉴了 EIP-8288 的核心思路。理由：签名列表不容易被其他 EVM 链扩展，帧模式更无需许可；同时清理掉原设计里的 ARBITRARY 签名类型。PR 把 leanSPHINCS 加为协议验证器，因为该方案预计能在 Hegotá 前定稿；命名的验证器预编译可以直接作为 PROOF 帧目标，消费 (key, msg, proof)，任何合约实现同样接口也能成为验证器。示例里的标准 paymaster 改为读取 PROOF 帧（新操作码 PROOFPARAM），不再自己做 ecrecover，协议会在其他帧执行前先验证所有声明。
items.title_en: PR #12714: add a PROOF frame mode to EIP-8141
items.note_en: Opened 2026-11-25 02:59 (lightclient, still open). The author says the team has gone back and forth on whether signature_list is sufficient and future compatible, and he now leans toward a dedicated frame mode for cryptographic claims, borrowing the core idea of EIP-8288. His reasons: other EVM chains cannot easily extend the signature list, a frame mode is more permissionless, and it removes the ARBITRARY signature type from the original design. The PR adds leanSPHINCS as a protocol verifier because the scheme should be finalized in time for Hegotá. Named verifier precompiles can be PROOF frame targets directly, consuming (key, msg, proof), and any contract that implements the same interface can become a verifier. The canonical paymaster example now reads a proof frame (new opcode PROOFPARAM) instead of calling ecrecover itself, since the protocol verifies every claim before any other frame runs.

items.title: PR #12710：EIP-8288 把依赖声明放进签名列表
items.note: 2026-11-24 17:50 创建（soispoke）。依赖不再用一个不执行代码的帧来声明，而是在 EIP-8141 的 signatures 列表里加一条 [LEANSPHINCS_SCHEME, public key, msg, empty]，空 msg 就代表交易签名哈希；三元组、递归证明、包装、FOCIL 和每个签名 33,000 gas 的价格都不变，账户用 SIGPARAM 读取。这与 #12714 的方向正好相反。
items.title_en: PR #12710: declare EIP-8288 dependencies in the signature list
items.note_en: Opened 2026-11-24 17:50 (soispoke). Instead of a frame that runs no code, a dependency becomes an entry in EIP-8141's signatures list: [LEANSPHINCS_SCHEME, public key, msg, empty]. An empty msg already stands for the transaction's signature hash. The triple, the recursive proof, the wrappers, FOCIL and the price of 33,000 gas per signature stay the same, and accounts read the entry with SIGPARAM. This points in the opposite direction from #12714.

items.note: 2026-11-24 20:52（nerolation）：EIP-8288（In-mempool signature and proof aggregation）的递归 STARK 移出区块头，作为 ExecutionPayload 的单独字段 recursiveStark；区块头保留 recursive_stark_hash 和 block_deps_hash 两个 32 字节字段，并新增 Engine API 一节。理由是区块头保持小，便于 skeleton sync，节点同步已最终确定的区块时可以不下载 STARK。
items.note_en: 2026-11-24 20:52 (nerolation): the recursive STARK in EIP-8288 (In-mempool signature and proof aggregation) moves out of the block header into a separate ExecutionPayload field, recursiveStark. The header keeps two 32-byte fields, recursive_stark_hash and block_deps_hash, and a new Engine API section is added. Smaller headers help skeleton sync and let nodes fetch finalized blocks without downloading the STARKs.

items.topic: 后量子路线：Keccak-256 统一哈希，PQ 共识和 PQ FOCIL 定节奏
items.title: EF 博客 PQAI #1
items.note: 2026-11-24（Kev Wedderburn）：推荐 Keccak-256 作为以太坊基于哈希的密码学的哈希，并使用 Keccak-f[1600] 派生的一组原语（Keccak-256 做标准哈希，Keccak-duplex 做 Fiat-Shamir，SHAKE256 做伪随机和密钥派生）。文章说二进制域 SNARK 和 GKR 证明器已能以每秒 50 万次哈希或更高的速度证明标准哈希，性能不再决定选择，安全性成为关键；比较了 Poseidon/Poseidon2、BLAKE3、BLAKE2、SHA2-256 和 Keccak-256。对客户端：执行层不需要新哈希，签名验证复用现有 Keccak-256，若随 Frame 交易在执行层引入 SSZ，建议用 Keccak-256；共识层长期建议把 SSZ 默克尔化从 SHA2-256 改为 Keccak-256。kevaundray 发帖介绍（2026-11-25 04:47），@ethereumfndn 引用转发（2026-11-25 05:32）。
items.note_en: 2026-11-24 (Kev Wedderburn), recommends Keccak-256 as the hash for Ethereum's hash-based cryptography, along with a family of primitives derived from Keccak-f[1600]: Keccak-256 for standard hashing, Keccak-duplex for Fiat-Shamir, and SHAKE256 for pseudorandomness and key derivation. The post says binary-field SNARKs and GKR-based provers now prove standard hashes at or well above 500K hashes per second, so performance no longer picks the winner and security does. It compared Poseidon/Poseidon2, BLAKE3, BLAKE2, SHA2-256 and Keccak-256. For clients: the execution layer needs no new hash and signature verification reuses existing Keccak-256 code; if SSZ comes to the execution layer with Frame transactions, Keccak-256 is recommended there. In the long term the consensus layer is advised to move SSZ merkleization from SHA2-256 to Keccak-256. kevaundray's post (2026-11-25 04:47), quoted by @ethereumfndn (2026-11-25 05:32).

items.title: PQ-CL Breakout #4
items.note: 2026-11-24 举行。按 EIPsInsight 的补充（2026-11-25 03:08）：XMSS 密钥生成延迟导致一次 55 个 slot 的重组，客户端在做预生成和缓存；LeanVM 0.17 用 FFI 取代 sidecar，递归快约 15%，所有客户端需协调更新；独立聚合者角色推迟出第一个 PQ 分叉。EIPsInsight 总结（2026-11-25 00:53）称 pq-devnet-1 将专注聚合和时序。下次会议 PQ-CL Breakout #5 在 11 月 27 日。
items.note_en: Took place on 2026-11-24. Per EIPsInsight's follow-up (2026-11-25 03:08): delayed XMSS key generation caused a 55-slot reorg and clients are working on pre-generation and caching; LeanVM 0.17 replaces the sidecar with FFI and recursion is about 15% faster, with all clients needing a coordinated update; a separate aggregator role is deferred from the first PQ fork. EIPsInsight's recap (2026-11-25 00:53) says pq-devnet-1 will focus on aggregation and timing. The next call, PQ-CL Breakout #5, is on November 27.

items.title: ERC-8511 Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts 讨论
items.note: Revinand 2026-11-24 19:54 指出，v2 中清空签名者和在 policySigner 为零时声明都立即生效，账户可在一笔交易内替换签名者并降低 minDelay；Zealynx 复现确认（20:22）。palisec-dev 发布 Registry v3（21:44）：部署在 Robinhood Chain（4663），无 owner、不可升级；账户触发的暂停只有账户能解除，发布者尝试会回滚；作者采纳“minDelay 只约束发布者”的解释，并在安全考虑里写明，需要约束账户本身的读者应监听 SignersDeclared 和账户发出的 PolicyActivated；客户端库升到 0.3.0。Zealynx 再指出（2026-11-25 01:09）泄露的发布者密钥可排队 type(uint64).max 版本，若账户错过窗口就永久卡住，建议 setPending 只允许版本加 1。ERCs PR #2196 已更新。
items.note_en: On 2026-11-24 at 19:54, Revinand pointed out that in v2 both clearing signers and declaring while policySigner is zero take effect immediately, so an account can swap its signers and lower minDelay in one transaction. Zealynx reproduced it (20:22). palisec-dev released Registry v3 (21:44) on Robinhood Chain (4663), with no owner and no upgrade path. A stop the account engaged can only be lifted by the account, and a publisher's attempt reverts. The author adopted the reading that minDelay binds the publisher only and now says so in Security Considerations; readers who need a delay on the account itself should watch SignersDeclared and PolicyActivated sent by the account. The client library is now 0.3.0. Zealynx then noted (2026-11-25 01:09) that a leaked publisher key could queue version type(uint64).max, which would get stuck permanently if the account misses the window, and suggested setPending only allow the next version. ERCs PR #2196 has been updated.

summary_en: lightclient opened a PR adding a PROOF frame mode to EIP-8141 Frame transactions, with leanSPHINCS as a protocol verifier, while soispoke proposed declaring EIP-8288 dependencies in the signature list instead, so two ways of expressing signatures are now being debated side by side. The EF blog published PQAI #1, recommending Keccak-256 as the single hash for Ethereum's hash-based cryptography, which means execution clients need no new hash. The ERC-8511 agent account registry moved to v3, and reviewers confirmed that minDelay binds the publisher, not the account itself.
